brief.meaningEn: The main distinction that separates two groups or options, rather than a minor surface difference.
brief.meaningZh: 區分兩組人或兩個選項的主要差異，而非表面小差別。
brief.grammar: Pattern: the real dividing line between X and Y is + distinguishing factor; a figurative noun phrase, not a boundary on a map.
brief.register: Analytical but accessible comparison: a teacher tells students which feature truly separates two similar reading clubs.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有足以區分兩組的實質特徵；只是字體或顏色不同，不一定是主要分野。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是地圖上的分界線，也不表示兩邊所有其他條件都不同。
brief.outcomeZh: 能先確認兩者相似之處，再指出真正令結果或功能不同的因素。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 59, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Mood is the real dividing line between these playlists.

listening.en: Both reading clubs meet on Fridays and have the same number of members. One discusses novels; the other writes its own stories. Activity is the real dividing line.
listening.zh: 兩個閱讀會都在星期五聚會，成員數目也相同。一個討論小說，另一個自行創作故事。活動內容才是真正的分野。
listening.promptZh: the real dividing line 在這裏指甚麼？

options.en: The type of activity is the main difference between the clubs.
options.zh: 活動類型是兩個閱讀會的主要差別。

options.en: The clubs meet on different days of the week.
options.zh: 兩個閱讀會在不同星期幾聚會。

options.en: One club has far more members than the other.
options.zh: 其中一個閱讀會的成員遠多於另一個。

options.en: A physical line on the floor separates the clubs.
options.zh: 地板上的實際界線把兩個閱讀會分開。

listening.explanationZh: 時間和人數相同；討論與創作的活動形式才區分兩者。

reply.promptEn: How do the two phone plans differ in a way that matters for overseas calls? Their price and data allowance match, but one includes international calls and the other allows only local calls.
reply.promptZh: （兩個電話計劃在海外通話方面有甚麼重要差別？兩者價格與數據量相同，但一個包括國際通話，另一個只可打本地電話。）

options.en: Only one plan includes international calls.
options.zh: 只有其中一個計劃包括國際通話。

options.en: The call coverage, not the price, separates them.
options.zh: 區分兩者的是通話範圍，不是價格。

options.en: International calling is the real dividing line between the plans.
options.zh: 國際通話功能是兩個計劃真正的分野。

options.en: Someone needing overseas calls gets different options under these otherwise similar plans.
options.zh: 需要打海外電話的人會發現兩個其他方面相似的計劃選擇不同。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以國際通話功能為關鍵差異；金句用本課表達。

scene.promptZh: 兩項義工服務都在同一社區中心舉行、服務同一群長者；甲每星期參與，乙每月只參與一次。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The real dividing line is how often volunteers need to attend.
options.zh: 真正的分野在於義工需要多久參與一次。

options.en: The services differ mainly because they help completely different people.
options.zh: 兩項服務主要差在服務完全不同的人。

options.en: The services take place in different districts.
options.zh: 兩項服務在不同地區舉行。

scene.explanationZh: 地點和對象相同；每週與每月的參與頻率才是關鍵差異。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項資料最不足以構成兩個方案的 real dividing line？

options.en: One course includes weekly feedback, while the other offers no feedback.
options.zh: 一個課程每週提供回饋，另一個沒有。

options.en: The menus offer the same dishes at the same price but use different font colours.
options.zh: 兩份餐牌菜式和價格相同，只是字體顏色不同。

options.en: One bus route runs hourly, while another runs every ten minutes.
options.zh: 一條巴士線每小時一班，另一條每十分鐘一班。

contrast.explanationZh: 只換字體顏色未構成實質功能或結果的主要分野。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「兩隊球員平均年齡一樣，所以一定完全沒有差別。」但一隊早上訓練，另一隊晚間訓練。你怎樣回應？

options.en: Their training schedule may be the real dividing line, even if their ages match.
options.zh: 即使年齡相若，訓練時間也可能是真正的分野。

options.en: The matching ages prove the two teams use identical schedules.
options.zh: 年齡相若就證明兩隊訓練時間完全相同。

options.en: Morning and evening training cannot affect how the teams operate.
options.zh: 早上與晚間訓練不可能影響隊伍運作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 年齡相同不消除訓練時間這項有實際影響的差異。

speaking.en: The real dividing line between the routes is reliability, not distance.
speaking.zh: 兩條路線真正的分野是可靠程度，不是距離。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪項因素才是比較重點。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩種圖書館會籍費用和開放時間一樣。甲只能借書，乙還可借工具；居民想借電鑽。用一至兩句英文指出真正影響居民選擇的差異。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出兩種會籍在費用和時間上相同，真正差在可否借工具。

examples.en: The real dividing line between the memberships is tool borrowing for the resident who needs a drill, since both have the same fee and hours.
examples.zh: 對需要電鑽的居民來說，兩種會籍真正的分野是可否借工具，因為費用和開放時間相同。

examples.en: For a resident who needs a drill, the real dividing line is that only Membership B includes tools. Both memberships have the same fee and hours.
examples.zh: 對需要電鑽的居民來說，真正的分野是只有乙會籍可借工具。兩種會籍的費用和開放時間相同。

glossary.en: a resident who needs a drill

takeaways.en: The real dividing line is the feature that materially separates two otherwise similar options.
takeaways.zh: 真正的分野是把兩個其他方面相似的選項實質區分開的特徵。

takeaways.en: The real dividing line need not be a visible line or a difference in every feature.
takeaways.zh: 真正的分野不必是可見的線，也不表示每個特徵都不同。

brief.meaningEn: Suit the mood or needs of an occasion in tone, style or response.
brief.meaningZh: 說話、表演或回應的語氣與場合氣氛相配。
brief.grammar: Pattern: message/song/person hit(s) the right note at/for an occasion; hit is unchanged in past. Figurative use is about appropriateness, not literal musical pitch.
brief.register: Sensitive event planning: a ceremony organiser explains to speakers why calm thanks fit a reflective gathering better than loud celebration.
brief.boundaryZh: 合乎場合不等於每個人都喜歡，也不保證每個音符唱得準。
brief.misconceptionZh: 在此不是只指唱對音高，而是整體語氣或表達方式恰當。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據場合的情緒和聽眾需要，判斷表達是否拿捏得宜。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 59, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The gentle song hit the right note after the ceremony.

listening.en: After the memorial, the organiser played a gentle song rather than a triumphant march. Its quiet tone hit the right note for the gathering.
listening.zh: 紀念活動後，籌辦人播放了一首柔和歌曲，而非勝利進行曲。這首歌的柔和語氣正好配合這場聚會。
listening.promptZh: hit the right note 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The song’s tone suited the reflective occasion.
options.zh: 歌曲的語氣適合這個沉思的場合。

options.en: The song was guaranteed to be everyone’s favourite.
options.zh: 這首歌保證是每個人最喜歡的。

options.en: Every singer reached the correct musical pitch.
options.zh: 每名歌手都唱準了每個音。

options.en: The organiser chose the loudest available music.
options.zh: 籌辦人選了音量最大的音樂。

listening.explanationZh: 柔和而不喧鬧的選擇符合紀念活動後的氣氛。

reply.promptEn: How did the host address volunteers after a difficult recovery project? She thanked their patience in a warm, restrained speech and avoided making jokes about the hardship.
reply.promptZh: （艱難的復修項目後，主持人怎樣向義工說話？她以溫暖而克制的致詞感謝耐心，沒有拿困難開玩笑。）

options.en: Her thanks matched the serious but appreciative mood.
options.zh: 她的感謝配合了嚴肅而又感激的氣氛。

options.en: She showed care without making light of the hardship.
options.zh: 她表達關懷，沒有輕視這段艱難。

options.en: Her speech hit the right note for the volunteers.
options.zh: 她的致詞在義工面前拿捏得宜。

options.en: The restrained tone suited what the team had been through.
options.zh: 克制的語氣符合團隊的經歷。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說表達方式適合當下氣氛；金句用 hit the right note。

scene.promptZh: 社區在暴雨後首次聚會，主席先感謝互相協助的居民，再安靜地悼念受影響家庭。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The chair’s remarks hit the right note for the gathering.
options.zh: 主席的說話為這次聚會拿捏了合適語氣。

options.en: The chair treated the storm as a joke to entertain the crowd.
options.zh: 主席把暴雨當笑話逗大家開心。

options.en: The chair ignored the affected families entirely.
options.zh: 主席完全忽略受影響家庭。

scene.explanationZh: 感謝與悼念兼顧，配合災後聚會的需要。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個回應最不可能 hit the right note？

options.en: A speaker offers quiet thanks after a difficult farewell.
options.zh: 艱難告別後，講者平靜表達感謝。

options.en: A presenter makes loud jokes about people’s losses during a condolence event.
options.zh: 慰問活動中，主持人大聲拿人們的損失開玩笑。

options.en: A host uses a cheerful welcome at a children’s birthday party.
options.zh: 兒童生日會上，主持人開心地歡迎來賓。

contrast.explanationZh: 拿損失開玩笑與慰問場合不相稱。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「剛完成默哀，我們立即播一首震耳欲聾的勝利歌曲吧。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: A gentler piece would probably hit the right note after a moment of silence.
options.zh: 默哀後播放較柔和的樂曲，語氣可能更合適。

options.en: The louder the music, the more respectful it must be.
options.zh: 音樂越大聲，就一定越尊重場合。

options.en: A moment of silence means every possible song is equally suitable.
options.zh: 默哀後所有歌曲都同樣合適。

dialogue.explanationZh: 較柔和的選擇更能延續默哀後的氛圍；probably 保留判斷餘地。

speaking.en: Her calm welcome hit the right note at the farewell, which was both grateful and sad.
speaking.zh: 那場告別會既感激又傷感，她平靜的歡迎詞拿捏得宜。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪種氣氛令語氣合適。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一位學校管理員退休，同事希望致詞既感謝他多年照顧學生，也避免誇張笑話；聽眾對溫暖而真誠的致詞表示欣賞。用一至兩句英文描述致詞為何合適。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出溫暖真誠的感謝和避免不合適笑話，不要聲稱人人都把致詞評為最精彩。

examples.en: The warm speech hit the right note by thanking the school caretaker for years of caring for students without forced jokes.
examples.zh: 溫暖的致詞拿捏得宜，因為它感謝學校管理員多年照顧學生，沒有勉強搞笑。

examples.en: At the retirement gathering, the speaker hit the right note by offering sincere thanks for the caretaker’s years of caring for students, without exaggerated humour.
examples.zh: 在退休聚會上，講者拿捏得宜，真誠感謝管理員多年照顧學生，也避免了誇張的笑話。

takeaways.en: Hit the right note means suit the situation’s mood, not simply sing an accurate pitch.
takeaways.zh: 拿捏合適的語氣，指配合場合氣氛，不只是唱準音高。

takeaways.en: A response can hit the right note without being every listener’s favourite.
takeaways.zh: 表達可以合乎場合，而不必是每個聽眾最喜歡的。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Source is guide-written provenance; practice scenes are newly written. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Be the leading or predominant option in a field, or set an example that others follow.
brief.meaningZh: 在某方面成為主要或領先的選擇，或樹立供其他人跟隨的榜樣。
brief.grammar: Pattern: person, organisation or method leads/led the way in + field/action, or leads the way for others; distinguish current leadership from a claim of being first ever.
brief.register: Measured public-service comparison: a school administrator tells families that app alerts now carry most notices, while printed notices remain for some households.
brief.boundaryZh: 走在前列可以指目前最主要的渠道或帶頭做法，不必表示歷史上第一個，也不保證在所有方面都最好。
brief.misconceptionZh: 這裏不是在路上帶隊行走；重點是做法領先或成為別人的參照。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出某做法是目前最主要的方式，或提供別人跟隨的範例，而不誇稱絕對首創。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 60, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Mobile apps now lead the way in local updates.

listening.en: Most families now receive school updates through the app, although printed notices remain available. App alerts lead the way in daily communication.
listening.zh: 大多數家庭現在透過程式接收學校消息，雖然紙本通知仍有提供。程式提示已成為日常通訊的主要方式。
listening.promptZh: lead the way 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: App alerts are now the main way families receive school updates.
options.zh: 程式提示現已成為家庭接收學校消息的主要方式。

options.en: Printed notices are no longer available to any family.
options.zh: 任何家庭都再無法收到紙本通知。

options.en: The school must have invented the first messaging app in the world.
options.zh: 這所學校一定發明了世上首個通訊程式。

options.en: Most families still use only printed notices for daily updates.
options.zh: 大多數家庭仍只靠紙本通知接收日常消息。

listening.explanationZh: 大多數家庭改用程式，支持它成為主要渠道；紙本仍存在，也不能推斷學校首創程式。

reply.promptEn: Why do colleagues call the local library a leader in accessible reading? It tested large-print guides, measured positive results, and four nearby libraries adopted its approach.
reply.promptZh: （為何同事說本地圖書館在無障礙閱讀方面走在前列？它測試大字指南，取得良好結果，附近四間圖書館也採用其做法。）

options.en: Nearby libraries followed its tested approach.
options.zh: 附近圖書館跟隨它試過的做法。

options.en: Its guides became a useful model for others.
options.zh: 它的指南成為其他館的有用範例。

options.en: The library led the way in accessible reading support.
options.zh: 圖書館在無障礙閱讀支援方面帶頭。

options.en: The pilot influenced other libraries beyond the first site.
options.zh: 試驗影響了首間館以外的其他圖書館。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都根據試驗成果及其他館的採用；金句用 lead the way。

scene.promptZh: 市民可透過櫃台、電話或網上預約社區運動場；去年七成預約來自網上，其餘兩種方式仍可使用。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Online booking leads the way in current reservations, although other options remain.
options.zh: 現時網上預約佔主導，但仍保留其他方式。

options.en: Counter bookings are still the main route for most users.
options.zh: 櫃台預約仍是大部分使用者的主要方式。

options.en: Online booking must have been invented by this sports centre.
options.zh: 網上預約一定是這個運動場首創的。

scene.explanationZh: 七成預約來自網上，支持它目前是主要渠道；不代表其他方式消失或運動場首創網上預約。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項證據最不足以說某團隊 led the way？

options.en: Other schools adapt the team’s tested accessibility guide.
options.zh: 其他學校採納並調整團隊試過的無障礙指南。

options.en: The team copies a mature programme after everyone else has adopted it, without changing it.
options.zh: 所有人採用成熟計劃後，團隊才原樣照搬。

options.en: A district’s pilot becomes the reference model for nearby districts.
options.zh: 某區的試驗成為鄰近地區的參考範本。

contrast.explanationZh: 只是較後照搬現成計劃，缺少帶頭或引領的證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我們是最後一個採用鄰市既有回收安排的地方，卻可以說我們 led the way。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: We followed their example, so we should not claim we led the way here.
options.zh: 我們跟隨了他們的做法，不應聲稱自己在這件事上帶頭。

options.en: Being last automatically makes our district the pioneer.
options.zh: 最後採用就自動令本區成為先驅。

options.en: The other city followed our plan before we adopted it.
options.zh: 另一座城市在我們採用前已跟隨我們的計劃。

dialogue.explanationZh: 按已知時間與採用關係，本區是跟隨者而非帶頭者。

speaking.en: The city’s low-floor buses lead the way in accessible transport because other districts now follow their design.
speaking.zh: 其他地區如今仿效其設計，因此這座城市的低地台巴士在無障礙交通方面走在前列。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪項證據支持帶頭。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一間診所目前用短訊、電話和書信提醒病人覆診。七成病人收到短訊，其餘人仍收到電話或信件；沒有資料顯示誰首創短訊提醒。用一至兩句英文描述現時的主要提醒渠道，不要聲稱診所發明了它。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出短訊現佔七成、電話和書信仍存在；不要把目前的主要渠道誤作歷史首創。

examples.en: Text reminders lead the way in the clinic’s appointment updates because seven in ten patients receive them, although calls and letters remain.
examples.zh: 短訊提醒目前是診所覆診通知的主要方式，因為十名病人中有七名收到短訊，但電話和書信仍然使用。

examples.en: At the clinic, text messages now lead the way for reminders: seven in ten patients get one, but others still receive calls or letters.
examples.zh: 在這間診所，短訊現時是主要提醒方式：十名病人中有七名收到短訊，其他人仍收到電話或信件。

takeaways.en: Lead the way can describe the main current option without proving who first invented it.
takeaways.zh: 走在前列可以指目前的主要選擇，不足以證明誰最先發明它。

takeaways.en: A team may lead the way locally without having invented an idea first in the world.
takeaways.zh: 團隊可在本地帶頭，而不必是全球首創。

lessons.titleEn: the centre of gravity has shifted

brief.meaningEn: The main focus or weight of activity has moved from one area to another.
brief.meaningZh: 活動、注意力或資源的主要重心已從一處轉往另一處。
brief.grammar: Pattern: the centre of gravity has shifted from X to/toward Y; use present perfect for a change with a current result. Other activity may remain at X.
brief.register: Measured media analysis: a community arts manager explains to colleagues that most engagement now occurs through local online events while in-person events continue.
brief.boundaryZh: 重心轉移不等於原來一邊完全消失；需要有活動、參與或資源分布的證據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是物理上有重物移動，而是主要焦點或投入方向改變。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出原來的重心、現在的新重心，以及仍保留甚麼舊做法。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 61, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: In entertainment, the centre of gravity has already shifted online.
sources.expression: the centre of gravity has already shifted

listening.en: The arts centre used to attract most visitors to its hall. Now most participants attend its online workshops, though the hall remains open. The centre of gravity has shifted online.
listening.zh: 藝術中心以前大部分參與者到場館；現在多數人參加網上工作坊，雖然場館仍開放。參與重心已轉往網上。
listening.promptZh: The centre of gravity has shifted online 在這裏指甚麼？

options.en: The main share of participation now happens online.
options.zh: 參與者的主要部分現在轉到網上。

options.en: The physical building has moved to a different location.
options.zh: 實體大樓已搬到另一個位置。

options.en: Every in-person event has ended permanently.
options.zh: 所有現場活動都已永久結束。

options.en: Online workshops have always attracted fewer people than the hall.
options.zh: 網上工作坊一直比場館吸引更少人。

listening.explanationZh: 多數參與者轉到網上，但場館仍開放。

reply.promptEn: What changed in the neighbourhood club’s communication? A paper newsletter was once its main channel; now most members use the group app, although a few still request printed copies.
reply.promptZh: （社區會的通訊方式有何轉變？紙本通訊以前是主要渠道；現在多數會員用群組程式，但仍有少數人要求紙本。）

options.en: Most communication now goes through the app.
options.zh: 大部分通訊現在透過程式進行。

options.en: Print still exists, but it is no longer the main channel.
options.zh: 紙本仍存在，但不再是主要渠道。

options.en: The centre of gravity has shifted from print to the app.
options.zh: 通訊重心已從紙本轉往程式。

options.en: The club changed its usual communication channel while keeping a print option.
options.zh: 社區會改變慣用通訊渠道，同時保留紙本選項。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出主渠道改變而紙本仍存在；金句用重心轉移概括。

scene.promptZh: 一間社區診所過去大部分職員時間用於即時處理小病，現在大部分時間用於預防講座，但仍保留小病門診。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The centre of gravity has shifted toward prevention, while treatment remains available.
options.zh: 工作重心已轉向預防，但診療服務仍然提供。

options.en: The clinic has stopped treating illness altogether.
options.zh: 診所已完全停止治病。

options.en: The clinic building has moved because its physical balance changed.
options.zh: 診所大樓因物理平衡改變而搬走。

scene.explanationZh: 大部分職員時間改投預防，舊服務卻仍保留。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以說 centre of gravity has shifted？

options.en: Most of a charity’s budget moves from print campaigns to community visits.
options.zh: 慈善團體的大部分預算從紙本宣傳轉到社區探訪。

options.en: A club changes its logo colour while its budget and activities remain the same.
options.zh: 社團換了標誌顏色，但預算和活動完全不變。

options.en: A library now spends most new funding on audio books instead of print.
options.zh: 圖書館現把大部分新增資金投在有聲書，而非紙本書。

contrast.explanationZh: 只換標誌顏色，沒有顯示活動或資源重心轉移。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「場館參與者現在只佔兩成，所以現場活動一定已完全取消。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: The centre of gravity has shifted online, but one fifth of participants still attend in person.
options.zh: 參與重心已轉往網上，但仍有五分之一的人現場參與。

options.en: The remaining one fifth proves all in-person events have stopped.
options.zh: 仍有五分之一現場參與者，證明所有現場活動都停止了。

options.en: If most people attend online, no one can enter the venue.
options.zh: 多數人網上參與，就表示沒有人能到場。

dialogue.explanationZh: 多數人網上參與顯示重心轉移，兩成現場參與則反駁完全取消。

speaking.en: The centre of gravity has shifted toward community clinics, although the main hospital remains open.
speaking.zh: 重心已轉向社區診所，雖然主要醫院仍然開放。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出重心轉移是否等於舊服務消失。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校圖書館過去以紙本借閱為主，現在多數借閱量來自電子書；紙本書仍可借。用一至兩句英文描述主要借閱方式的轉變及保留的舊方式。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出從紙本轉向電子書的主要借閱變化，同時保留紙本仍可借。

examples.en: The centre of gravity has shifted from print to e-books in the school library, although paper books remain available.
examples.zh: 學校圖書館的借閱重心已從紙本轉往電子書，雖然紙本書仍可借閱。

examples.en: In the school library, the centre of gravity has shifted toward e-book loans, but students can still borrow printed books.
examples.zh: 在學校圖書館，借閱重心已轉向電子書，但學生仍可借紙本書。

takeaways.en: The centre of gravity has shifted when the main focus moves, even if old activity continues.
takeaways.zh: 重心已轉移指主要焦點改變，即使舊活動仍繼續。

takeaways.en: A change in colour alone does not show that the centre of gravity has shifted.
takeaways.zh: 單是顏色改變不足以顯示重心已轉移。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Source is guide-written provenance; practice scenes are newly written. No human or release approval is implied.
